summary.text: A battlefield killer move shapes a fight space itself: an environment that amplifies chosen Gu, isolates the field, or traps enemies inside a domain.

claims.text: Fairy Li Shan names pear orchard as a battlefield killer move when trees and blossoms form a forested trap around her. Xue Song Zi answers with snow domain, and Hei Cheng with dark veil. Each move remakes the local battlefield rather than firing a single projectile technique.

A battlefield killer move creates a battlefield environment that amplifies the effects of certain Gu worms. Ordinary Gu Immortals do not casually possess such methods. Inside that dark, fogged field, pale green flames gain amplified power against crane groups, showing how the environment itself is part of the technique’s strength.

Rolling Rock Battlefield is an immortal level battlefield killer move. Forming such a move needs at least three Immortal Gu connected in some way. The grey rock domain expands to cover both fighter and foe, and from outside it looks like a huge grey rock cloud that blocks vision. The move isolates the inside and outside of the domain.

Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable was most skilled in battlefield killer moves. Fairy Yu Lu, his second disciple, learned that core and created her own versions. One such move has no attacking power but a huge range; paired with vanishing immortal essence dissipation rain it drains invaders rather than smashing them. Wisdom path deduction can fail against a profound battlefield killer move, and even an Immortal Gu House may only allow escape from the blessed land rather than a break of the field.

Battlefield killer moves can create an independent battlefield environment isolated from the world. Inside that field, Gu Immortals are often unable to use information path Gu worms to call for reinforcements, though that limit is not absolute. Superior battlefield killer moves can also limit space and stop an enemy from fleeing freely. Pear orchard is again named as Fairy Li Shan’s battlefield killer move in that talk.

Immortal battlefield killer moves have another name: quasi blessed lands. Once used, they temporarily replicate countless dao marks and create a temporary unique battlefield. Most Gu Immortals do not possess them.
Immortal grade fields and that quasi blessed land label are covered on Immortal Battlefield.

Wisdom path inheritances can include detailed methods for dismantling battlefield killer moves. Gu Immortals of other paths still keep useful personal methods for dealing with them, even without wisdom path techniques.

Orchard garden in mountain combines earth path and wood path: pear blossoms and coiling vines are wood path techniques, while the pulling gravity is earth path. The trapping field is still a battlefield killer move even when amplified by other resources such as Miniscule Mountain.

Talk of battlefield killer moves clashing with an immortal aperture’s dao marks refers to immortal battlefield killer moves. Fang Yuan’s dark veil is mortal level and is not problematic inside the aperture on that rule. He also holds Xue Song Zi’s mortal battlefield killer move snow domain.
Killer moves as Gu combinations in general are covered on killer moves.
